_meta.description: Suburban-SOC Agent Orchestration Checkpoints. Stores phase transitions (PENDING_APPROVAL, EXECUTED) to enable idempotency and crash recovery for the agent loop, keyed by alert_id (checkpoints.py does upsert-by-id GET/PUT plus an op_type=create claim doc). #245: NOT a data stream - a data stream only accepts op_type=create writes and has no GET-by-id, which write_checkpoint()/read_checkpoint() both need. No ILM policy: ILM ages out whole indices, not individual documents, and agent-checkpoints-<tenant> is a single always-growing index keyed by alert_id, not time-series data - retention needs a per-document TTL mechanism (tracked separately, see the compact_agent_approval_queue.py precedent for the same class of problem).
